# Pesher Habakkuk Column 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** Well preserved

---

**7:1** "Therefore he unsheathes his sword continually

**7:2** to slay nations

**7:3** without mercy" (Hab 1:17).

**7:4** Its interpretation concerns the Kittim, who destroy

**7:5** many with the sword — youths, adults, and the aged,

**7:6** women and children; and even upon the fruit of

**7:7** the womb they have no mercy.

**7:8** "I will stand at my watch

**7:9** and station myself on my watchtower, and I will wait to see

**7:10** what He will say to me, and what I shall answer

**7:11** regarding my complaint. And the LORD answered me

**7:12** and said: 'Write down the vision and make it plain

**7:13** upon the tablets, so that the one who reads it

**7:14** may run'" (Hab 2:1-2).

**7:15** Its interpretation: God commanded Habakkuk to write down the things

**7:16** that were coming upon the last generation,

**7:17** but the consummation of the end-time He did not make known to him.

---
*LOGOS notes: Column 7 covers Hab 1:17-2:2. This translation maintains formal equivalence while rendering readable English. The pesher (interpretation) sections apply Habakkuk's prophecy to the Qumran community's historical situation. Key figures: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, the Kittim (Romans). "Interpretation" used consistently for pesher. Lacunae [...] indicate physical manuscript damage.*
